provenance.source: ParaVision DICOM exports of a water phantom in head-prone and head-supine position; local and not in Git
provenance.coordinate_system: DICOM patient coordinates (LPS) in mm, anatomical orientation type QUADRUPED; ImagePositionPatient is the centre of the first voxel
provenance.paravision_parsing: values as parsed by hypermri's BrukerHandler from method, acqp, scan-level visu_pars and pdata/1/reco; null marks an absent parameter
provenance.excluded: pixel data, names, identifiers, UIDs, dates, times, device, coil and institution details, sequence and protocol names, source folder names
